annotation_author: Codex visual inspection of user-provided originals
scope: All 280 unique formally analyzed pages: prior 220 references and results unchanged plus all 60 frozen new validation pages.
policy: Speech, thoughts, punctuation balloons, narration, thematic chapter headings, character biographies, explanatory labels and story footnotes are included. Physically connected lobes are one stop; order refers to their first lobe, not internal interleaving. Bare vocal exclamations are included; breathing effects, mechanical SFX outside balloons, physical signage, series logos, credits, cover galleries, promotional/editorial pages are excluded. SFX enclosed in actual balloons are retained. Ambiguous interpretations are recorded per page.
